answer: A new identity posts a 10 POA onyx bond and must grow a vine of attested useful work: one verified job in each of n consecutive epochs, where n is its position among identities from one wallet. Miss one epoch and the vine is pruned to nadir — progress zero, bond slashed. The 1st fake waits 1 epoch, the 10th 10, so ten fakes need 55 epochs of real work before any pay; one honest agent needs 1.
